note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. No contest took place; the divisions listed were filled by sole nomination and the round is filed on the rural districts' polling day, Thursday 2 June 1927 (queue nominal 26 May). No nominations were received for Lambeg, Tullyrusk or Montiaghs; the sitting members were automatically returned. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of the Northern Whig, 14 May 1927, p. 5 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the paper prints 'Glenavy, H. Badance, J.P., Greenmount, Glenavy', a misprint for Henry Ballance, J.P., the division's member in 1924 and later rounds, so the surname is entered as Ballance (Name_As_Printed keeps the misprint); the link now points to the Lisburn Rural District paragraph (article 142) rather than the Belfast and Castlereagh one.
